description: A fragment class for logging that displays log data within a LogView inside a ScrollView, enabling viewing logs in an Android app.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass responsible for displaying and managing a LogView inside a ScrollView, facilitating log output and view updates in an Android application.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Constructs and returns the view hierarchy containing a ScrollView with a LogView inside, configured with styling and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Handles the fragment's view creation, sets up text change listener for auto-scrolling on log updates.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
